findings.title: The two units must be separated by vertical and/or horizontal fire-resistance-rated assemblies of 1 hour, or 1/2 hour when the building is sprinklered throughout per CRC R309 (NFPA 13D or R309.3). Applies whether or not a lot line runs between the units. Assemblies must be continuous: walls run to the foundation and to the underside of roof sheathing (or a rated ceiling/floor), floors run tight to exterior walls or the rated wall.
findings.detail: Plans should show: Floor plans/sections tagging the unit separation wall and/or floor with a tested assembly (UL/GA number, ASTM E119/UL 263) and its rating; detail showing continuity to foundation and roof sheathing; sprinkler note if 1/2-hour is used.
findings.evidence: A-201 wall legend: '2x6 INTERIOR STUD WALL (60 MINUTES FIRE RESISTANCE RATING). REFER TO ____ ... SEPARATION BETWEEN UNITS'; no listed assembly number; continuity details (A-803, A-806 to A-809) not included.

findings.title: Group R exterior walls by fire separation distance X (Table 705.5): X < 5 ft: 1 hour (all types); 5 <= X < 10 ft: 1 hour; 10 <= X < 30 ft: 1 hour, except Types II-B and V-B: 0; X >= 30 ft: 0. For Group R the rating is for exposure from both sides. Footnote: R-3 of Type II-B or V-B needs no rating at X >= 5 ft, or X >= 3 ft when sprinklered per 903.3. Load-bearing exterior walls must also meet Table 601: I-A 3, I-B 2, II-A 1, II-B 0, III-A 2, III-B 2, IV-HT 2, V-A 1, V-B 0 hours.
findings.detail: Plans should show: Site plan dimensioning each wall to property line / assumed line between buildings; wall legend giving rating for walls inside the trigger distance; construction type on cover sheet.
findings.evidence: No site plan or distances to property lines; A-100 requires site plan to be provided.

source.title: 2025 California Building Code (Title 24 Part 2), UpCodes

findings.title: Sprinklered dwellings (Table R302.1(2), the case in Irvine): walls with fire separation distance < 3 ft need 1-hour rating (exposure from outside); no openings < 3 ft; no projections < 2 ft, projections 2-3 ft need 1-hour underside. Unsprinklered (Table R302.1(1)): walls < 5 ft need 1 hour with exposure from both sides; no openings < 3 ft; openings limited to 25% of wall area at 3-5 ft. Dwellings on the same lot use an imaginary line between them.
findings.detail: Plans should show: Site plan with distances from each wall and eave to property line; rated wall/eave details where inside 3 ft (sprinklered) or 5 ft (unsprinklered); opening schedule near property lines.
